text: しかし　エレベータは　カギが　ないと　つかえないぜ！

structure.jp: しかし　エレベータは

patterns.name: 〜ないと〜ない
patterns.span: ないと　つかえない
patterns.explanation: ないと followed by another 'not' says that without the first thing the second cannot happen. ないと　つかえない = 'you can't use it without one'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing つかう to つかえる adds the meaning 'can', and ない makes it 'cannot'. つかえない = 'can't use'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, manly way of pushing your point. つかえないぜ = 'you can't use it, I tell you'.
